facts.value: Resets velocity, stores the supplied braking magnitude after negating negative inputs, retains ref_gobj, performs common item/map setup and selects motion state 4. State-4 physics consumes a nonzero pending x10 override and then brakes horizontal velocity toward zero. Its collision callback clears the association after becoming airborne, enters state 5 and clears the association on obstruction, or returns to state 0 when grounded without a link. State-5 entry initializes a counter to 90; its collision callback checks expiry before decrement and can also enter falling through the shared support check, so recovery is not an unconditional exact 90-frame pause.

facts.value: Motion state 0 slides, 1 falls, 2 is held, 3 is thrown, 4 decelerates an externally linked spawn, and 5 is stopped recovery. State 5 initializes its counter to 90, decrements positive values and restores sliding on a later check when the counter is already nonpositive. Its shared collision processing can select falling state 1 before the counter branch; the expired branch can subsequently select state 0. Motion indices are distinct from animation IDs, and states 1 and 3 share an inert animation callback.

facts.value: Always stores the supplied float in freeze.x10 and refreshes both lifetime timers without directly changing motion state or x40_vel. On a state-4 physics update, a nonzero x10 replaces horizontal velocity and is cleared before braking. Supplying zero instead clears any pending override; it does not directly stop existing horizontal velocity, although ordinary state-4 braking still applies. Repeated calls overwrite the pending value and refresh lifetime again.
